RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Drone Call
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Summon two nearby crystal drones for 15 seconds. Base cooldown: 18 seconds. Summons snapshot 25% of owner bonus health, 35% of bonus damage and summon-specific bonuses. Cap: six per owner and 24 per map. No gear, products or owner on-hit rewards. They vanish if the owner leaves the map or loses player control.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Echo Projection
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Summon two nearby combat echoes for 15 seconds. Base cooldown: 24 seconds. Summons snapshot 25% of owner bonus health, 35% of bonus damage and summon-specific bonuses. Cap: six per owner and 24 per map. No gear, products or owner on-hit rewards. They vanish if the owner leaves the map or loses player control.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Sanctuary Ring
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Gain Sanctuary Ring: protect yourself and visible colonists within 5 cells from direct damage for 1 second. Base cooldown: 30 seconds. Disease, missing organs and delayed injury debts still apply.
